achievement.1.description: Una macho kwa maeneo ya kutiliwa shaka na unapenda kusoma shajara za watu wengine, haswa zile zilizo na hadithi za vampire ndani yake. Wewe pia ni mkusanyaji na mgunduzi aliyejitolea. Heshima!
achievement.1.name: Castlemania
achievement.2.description: Lalalala... sasa unajua wimbo wa ibada ulioimbwa Liberty Bay kwa moyo. Sio ngumu sana, kwa kuzingatia kwamba ina maelezo mawili na maneno ya kurudia.
achievement.2.name: Kwaya
achievement.3.description: Muuza maziwa ni nani? Wewe ni!
achievement.3.name: Mkamuaji maziwa
achievement.4.description: Umekuwa mwasi kila wakati - kubali! Kusambaza wafungwa, kutunza waliofukuzwa, kuiba kutoka kwa matajiri na kutoa kwa maskini - hakuna kusubiri, hiyo ilikuwa hadithi nyingine.
achievement.4.name: Vive la Upinzani
achievement.5.description: Hams rahisi na mkate hufanya tu ucheke. Wewe ni bwana wa extra-ordinaire, melter ya jibini, kikaango cha mabawa ya popo na shaker ya shakes. Ladha!
achievement.5.name: Mwalimu wa upishi
achievement.6.description: Ulipata lulu mia moja nzuri kwenye maganda makubwa ya bahari. Kufikia sasa mkufu huo unapaswa kumalizika - na tunatumahi kuwa hukubanwa vidole vyako mara nyingi sana wakati wa mchakato.
achievement.6.name: Mtafuta Shell
achievement.7.description: Ikiwa mtu alipoteza kitu bila mpangilio mahali fulani, labda wewe ni mtu mzuri kuuliza na kwenda kukitafuta, hata kama hujui nini na wapi.
achievement.7.name: Mtalii wa mkoba
achievement.8.description: Hujali sheria ambazo wengine huweka na kuunda ulimwengu kwa kupenda kwako. Ukiwa umeacha nyuma mikusanyiko na maadili yasiyo na maana, unathamini tu uwezo unaotumia. Wewe ni bwana wa hatima yako na vita vya kusafisha ulimwengu.
achievement.8.name: Hofu Bwana
achievement.9.description: Ulijidhihirisha - sio tu katika ndoto zako - na una akili kali na ya kiroho. Pambano lako shupavu dhidi ya pepo na pigo lisiloweza kufa limekupa daraja la juu na linaloheshimika zaidi kati ya Nightmare Knights.
achievement.9.name: Lord Protector
achievement.10.description: Unafuata njia ya ndoto na ile ya uwajibikaji bila nguvu ya ubinafsi. Bila uchoyo na ubinafsi, unasaidia wengine bila kutarajia malipo.
achievement.10.name: Knight ndoto
achievement.11.description: Umejiunga na ndugu wasiokufa - kufanya kifo kuwa adui yako na silaha yako pia. Kula kilicho dhaifu na kuacha nafasi kwa kilicho na nguvu ndilo lengo lako kuu.
achievement.11.name: Ndugu Mfupa
achievement.12.description: Ulisafiri ulimwenguni kwa maombi karibu yasiyo na maana - lakini angalau sio lazima ufanye hivyo tena na unaweza kupata hisa mpya iliyobarikiwa kwa kupepesa kwa jicho.
achievement.12.name: Ubarikiwe!
achievement.13.description: Wewe ni mfanyabiashara hodari ambaye unaweza kushughulikia bidhaa kwa uangalifu, hupata ofa nzuri na huchimbua nadra kila mara. Kamwe usichelewe kukamilisha agizo, wewe ni mfanyabiashara anayeaminika - angalau machoni pa Rashid.
achievement.13.name: Mfanyabiashara Anayetambulika
achievement.14.description: Ulipata na kunywa kutoka Chemchemi ya Uzima. Ulifikiri haikukupa uzima wa milele, unahisi kubadilika na kwa namna fulani kuwa na amani.
achievement.14.name: Chemchemi ya Uzima
achievement.15.description: Ulisafiri ulimwengu wa nyanja za msingi, ukamwita na kumuua Bwana wa Vipengele, yote ili kupata jambo lisiloegemea upande wowote. Na kama ulivyokuwa jasiri, haungeweza kuifanya bila timu yako!
achievement.15.name: Bwana wa Vipengele
achievement.16.description: Uliigiza tena Ufugaji wa Shrew kwenye mazingira ya ufuo na kuthibitisha kuwa unaweza kushughulikia wasichana wasio na akili vizuri kabisa. Na au bila mikia ya samaki.
achievement.16.name: Pwani Tamer
achievement.17.description: Unapofanya kitu, unafanya sawa. Una maoni na unasimama nayo - na hakuna mtu atakayeweza kukushawishi vinginevyo. Kwa upande mwingine, uko upande wa kikatili na wenye mwelekeo wa vita, lakini hilo si jambo baya, sivyo?
achievement.17.name: Mfuasi wa Azerus
achievement.18.description: Wewe ni mlinzi wa amani na sikiliza watu wadogo wanasema nini. Umeamua na unajua ni nani wa kusaidia na kwa sababu zipi - na unafanya hivyo mara kwa mara. Vita yako inapiganwa kwa sababu badala ya silaha.
achievement.18.name: Mfuasi wa Palimuth
achievement.19.description: Unaruka katika kila fursa ya changamoto ya uwindaji ambayo hutolewa kwako na kutekeleza majukumu hayo kwa usahihi mbaya. Wewe ni mwindaji moyoni na mwanachama muhimu wa Paw & Fur Society.
achievement.19.name: Wawindaji wa Wasomi
achievement.20.description: Unajua kazi za uwindaji na umefanya chache tayari. Kazi nzuri kama mwindaji wa jamii ya Paw & Fur iko mbele!
achievement.20.name: Huntsman
achievement.21.description: Kwa wewe, busu ni zaidi ya kugusa rahisi ya midomo. Unambusu wasichana na mapigo ya kufa sawa kwa upendo usio na kifani na ulikabili kifo na kuzaliwa upya kupitia busu la malkia wa banshee. Wana bahati ni wale ambao wanapata kushiriki wakati wa karibu sana na wewe!
achievement.21.name: Kisser mwenye shauku
achievement.22.description: Umejithibitisha kama mwanachama anayestahili wa 'familia' na umefanikiwa kutekeleza misheni nyingi za kijasusi kwa 'mjomba wako' ili kusaidia wafanyabiashara wa Venorea na malengo yao.
achievement.22.name: Wakala wa juu wa AVIN
achievement.23.description: Nguvu ya msichana! Iwe wewe ni mwanamke au la, umethibitisha uaminifu kamili na nia ya kuweka maisha yako hatarini kwa ajili ya brigedi ya wasichana ya Carlin.
achievement.23.name: Wakala wa juu wa CGB
achievement.24.description: Njama na siri zilizo wazi ndio mkate wako wa kila siku. Umeonyesha uaminifu kwa taji la Thai kupitia ujasiri wako unapokabiliana na maadui na kukamilisha misheni ya kijasusi. Wewe ni wakala bora wa TBI.
achievement.24.name: Wakala wa juu wa TBI
achievement.25.description: Pakia vifaa vyako vya upelelezi na uwe tayari kwa misheni hatari katika huduma ya wakala wa siri. Umeonyesha unataka - lakini unaweza kuifanya kweli? Muda utasema.
achievement.25.name: Wakala wa Siri
achievement.26.description: Wewe ni fundi mago-mekanika. Sayansi na uchawi hufanya kazi pamoja machoni pako - na ingawa labda ulilipa gharama nyingi zisizo sahihi ulipokuwa unafanya kazi kwa Telas, unaweza kuwa na ujuzi wa kutosha kuunda golem yako mwenyewe sasa.
achievement.26.name: Golem katika Gia
achievement.27.description: Mashairi, mistari, nyimbo na mashairi ambayo umekariri mara nyingi. Umepita mlango wa siri, mjuzi wa hadithi za zamani. Hata elves umewaacha wakiwa wamevutiwa, kwa hivyo inaonekana umebarikiwa kweli.
achievement.27.name: Mshairi Mshindi wa Tuzo
achievement.28.description: Unaweza kushughulikia ala yoyote ya muziki uliyopewa - na kwa hakika uweze kutoa sauti ya kupendeza nayo. Wewe ni mgeni aliyekaribishwa na mburudishaji katika tavern nyingi.
achievement.28.name: Mwanamuziki
achievement.29.description: Unajua Banuta anapenda sehemu ya nyuma ya mkono wako na ni hodari katika kuharibu mikoba na mikojo. Kuonekana kwa nyayo kubwa hakukuzuii kuzuru maeneo yasiyojulikana pia.
achievement.29.name: Rafiki wa Nyani
achievement.30.description: Ramani yako ni rafiki yako - daima iko kwenye mfuko wako wa nyuma na kufunikwa na alama nyingi za maeneo ya kuvutia na muhimu. Mtu anaweza kusema kwamba unaweza kupotea bila hiyo - lakini kwa bahati nzuri hakuna njia ya kuiondoa kutoka kwako.
achievement.30.name: Eneo
achievement.31.description: Umethibitisha kuwa mshirika muhimu wa Marid, na Gabel alikukaribisha kufanya biashara na Haroun na Nah'Bob wakati wowote unapotaka. Ingawa vita vya Djinn bado havijaisha, Marid hawawezi kushindwa na wewe kwa upande wao.
achievement.31.name: Marid Ally
achievement.32.description: Ingawa Efreet alikukaribisha tu kwa kusita na kukuona kama "binadamu tu" kwa muda mrefu, uliweza kumvutia Malor na kupata heshima yake na chaguzi za biashara na djinns za kijani.
achievement.32.name: Efreet Ally
achievement.33.description: Ndoto - ni ukweli wako? Maono ya ajabu, saa zinazoyoma, kwenda kulala na kuamka mahali pengine kabisa - hiyo ilikuwa safari fulani, lakini una hakika kwamba uliifurahia.
achievement.33.name: Lucid Dreamer
achievement.34.description: Umetembelea sehemu ambazo watu wengi hawazijui hata majina. Kukusanya sampuli za mimea, zoologic na ectoplasmic ni biashara yako ya kila siku na uko tayari kugundua upeo mpya kila wakati.
achievement.34.name: Mchunguzi
achievement.35.description: Hata mazingira mabaya ya chini ya maji hayakuzuii kufanya jukumu lako kwa Jumuiya ya Wachunguzi. Kuchunguza eneo la Quara ni kipande cha keki kwako.
achievement.35.name: Scout ya Bahari
achievement.36.description: Wow - hiyo ilikuwa nini? Hujui jinsi ulivyoishia hapa, lakini kwa namna fulani ulifanya. Jinsi ya kutoka kwa Beregar hadi Kazordoon kwa haraka - hilo ni jambo ambalo watu wadogo wangependa kujua, lakini huna uhakika kabisa jinsi ya kuizalisha tena.
achievement.36.name: Uwezekano Pathfinder
achievement.37.description: Joto, mwenye manyoya na mkunjo - ingawa dubu yule yule uliyemkumbatia labda angekupasua vipande vipande ikiwa alikuwa na fahamu, alikukumbusha juu ya dubu yule mzee ambaye alilala kitandani mwako wakati ungali mdogo.
achievement.37.name: Bearhugger
achievement.38.description: Huwawinda, unazungumza nao. Unajua kwamba mizimu inaweza kuweka siri ambazo zimepotea kwa muda mrefu kati ya walio hai, na una ujuzi wa kuzungumza nao ili kukufunulia.
achievement.38.name: Ghostwhisperer
achievement.39.description: Una sehemu laini kwa wanyama wadogo, dhaifu, na unafanya kila uwezalo kuwalinda - hata kama labda unakula mazimwi kwa kiamsha kinywa.
achievement.39.name: Mwanaharakati wa Wanyama
achievement.40.description: Umekumbatia dubu, kusukuma mamalia na kuthibitisha ujuzi wako wa kunywa. Na ingawa una hangover kidogo, mbavu iliyovunjika kwa kiasi na nywele zenye mafuta kwenye ulimi wako, unajivunia kujiita msomi wa heshima kuanzia sasa.
achievement.40.name: Msomi wa heshima
achievement.41.description: Wewe ndiye unayeuliza maswali hapa, na unajua jinsi ya kupata majibu unayotaka kusikia. Mbali na hilo, wewe ni mtoaji pepo mashuhuri na unaua Vampires na mapepo wachache hapa na pale. Wewe na wadau wako ni timu kamili.
achievement.41.name: Mdadisi Mkuu
achievement.42.description: Weehee! Vunja minyoo hiyo! Hakika unajua jinsi ya kushughulikia nyundo kubwa.
achievement.42.name: Worm Whacker
achievement.43.description: Huna uhakika ni nini, lakini unahisi kuvutiwa na mrahaba. Magoti yako kila mara huchungiwa kidogo kutokana na kutambaa mbele ya viti vya enzi na unapenda kubarizi kwenye majumba. Labda unapaswa kuzingatia kuomba kama mlinzi?
achievement.43.name: Mfalme Tibianus shabiki
achievement.44.description: Wewe ni mwanariadha mwepesi na ni mzuri katika kuwasilisha bidhaa ambazo zinaweza kuoza kwa wakati, hata kama huwezi kutumia njia yoyote ya usafiri au mikono yako ikipata baridi au kunuka.
achievement.44.name: Kwa Wakati tu
achievement.45.description: Unapenda kuwachezea wengine vicheshi na kuwahadaa ili waonekane mjinga kidogo. Ndimi za kutikiswa husema kwamba wakati wa utambuzi machoni pa wahasiriwa wako ndio thawabu unayolisha, lakini labda unatania tu na kufurahiya nao ... sivyo?
achievement.45.name: Perfect Fool
achievement.46.description: Wakati mwingine siri kubwa za maisha zinaweza kuwa na suluhisho rahisi.
achievement.46.name: Mathemagician
achievement.47.description: Kuwasilisha barua na vifurushi daima imekuwa shauku yako ya siri, na sasa unaweza kuweka rasmi kofia yako ya bluu, kupiga pembe yako ya posta na kufanya kile unachopenda kufanya zaidi. Jihadharini na mbwa!
achievement.47.name: Archpostman
achievement.48.description: Huamini katika mapenzi kuwa jambo la bahati mbaya au katika mapenzi mara ya kwanza. Kwa kweli - potions za upendo, bouquets ya maua na mashairi ya cheesy hufanya hila bora zaidi kuliko hapo awali. Acha hizo homoni ziendelee!
achievement.48.name: Matchmaker
achievement.49.description: Wewe ni mmoja wa Watibia wachache ambao Armenius alichagua kuonyesha uso wake halisi - na alikufanya upigane naye. Labda hiyo inamaanisha kuwa una bahati sana au bahati mbaya sana, lakini jambo moja ni la hakika - ni nadra sana.
achievement.49.name: Uso Wake wa Kweli
achievement.50.description: Watu wenye meno makali ya mbwa wajihadhari nawe, haswa wakati wa usiku, au wanaweza kupata hisa kati ya mbavu zao. Wewe ni mwindaji wa vampire bila huruma na umekusanya ishara nyingi kama uthibitisho.
achievement.50.name: Razing!
achievement.51.description: Kuiba, kujialika kwa vyama vya watu mashuhuri, kughushi kandarasi na kujifanya kuwa mtu mwingine - wewe ni jack wa biashara zote linapokuja suala la shughuli haramu. Huchukui wafungwa, isipokuwa samaki wa dhahabu mara kwa mara.
achievement.51.name: Mwizi bwana
achievement.52.description: Umesaidia kuwafufua Princess Buttercup, Doctor Dumbness na Lucky the Wonder Dog - na labda utawaota usiku wa leo, kwa kuwa ulikariri mistari yako kikamilifu. Nini .. kipande maalum cha.. skrini.
achievement.52.name: Muigizaji Amateur
achievement.53.description: Unazima moto wa Roho wa Moto kwenye uwanja wa Svargrond. Mapambano ya uwanjani ni kwa ajili yako - haki, mraba, na sheria rahisi na vita ya moja kwa moja.
achievement.53.name: Scrapper
achievement.54.description: Ulimfutilia mbali Orcus the Cruel kwenye Uwanja wa Svargrond. Bado wewe ni kijani kidogo nyuma ya masikio, lakini kuna uwezo mkubwa.
achievement.54.name: Greenhorn
achievement.55.description: Ulimpeleka Mwangalizi kwenye uwanja wa Svargrond na kuwashinda maadui wengine tisa hatari njiani. Kila la kheri Mbabe wa Vita wa Svargrond!
achievement.55.name: Mkuu wa vita wa Svargrond
achievement.56.description: Wewe ni mmoja wa mashujaa jasiri kukabiliana na kuwashinda mwaloni wa ajabu wa pepo na wakosoaji wote ambao ilitupa usoni mwako. Ukiwa umeshika shoka lako lililobarikiwa hakuna mti unaothubutu kusimama katika njia yako - ya kishetani au la.
achievement.56.name: Herbicide
achievement.57.description: Umeruka kwa ujasiri katika Mwangamizaji maarufu na kunusurika - ukichukua umaarufu, utukufu na thawabu yako.
achievement.57.name: Annihilator
achievement.58.description: Uliweza kupambana na njia yako kupitia vikundi vingi vya watu kwenye Demon Forge. Kwa mara nyingine tena umethibitisha kuwa hakuna lisilowezekana.
achievement.58.name: Mwalimu wa Nexus
achievement.59.description: Wewe ni bwana au bibi wa densi - na hauogopi kutumia ujuzi wako kuwavutia miungu ya kikabila. Hatua moja kwenda kushoto, kuruka moja kwenda kulia, pinduka na kupiga kelele!
achievement.59.name: Mchezaji Mwenye Vipaji
achievement.60.description: Kwa tabasamu lisilo na madhara kabisa, uliwahadaa watu wote wa kuchekesha kula vidakuzi vyako vinavyolipuka. Wakati mwingine utakapovuta mzaha huu, zingatia kuvaa vazi la Skauti ya Wavulana ili kuifanya kuwa bora zaidi.
achievement.60.name: Ungependa kuruhusu Vidakuzi?
achievement.61.description: Umegusa viti vyote vya enzi vya Wale Saba Wakatili na kufyonza baadhi ya roho wao mbaya. Huenda imekubadilisha milele.
achievement.61.name: Asiye na huruma
achievement.62.description: Ulishinda shindano la timu 2 dhidi ya 2 bila huruma kwenye Isle of Strife na kuondosha wimbi baada ya wimbi la wapinzani wa kutisha. Kifo au ushindi - hakika ulichagua mwisho.
achievement.62.name: Bingwa wa Chazorai
achievement.63.name: Wayfarer
achievement.64.description: Jambo moja ni hakika: Hakika unapenda kuogelea. Kubarizi ufukweni na marafiki zako, kuwa na aiskrimu na kucheza mpira wa ufukweni ni furaha tele!
achievement.64.name: Waverider
achievement.65.description: Muziki hukujia tu kwa kawaida. Unajisikia vizuri kwenye hatua yoyote, wakati wowote, na unatumai kwa siri kwamba siku moja utaweza kuwashinda maadui zako kwa kucheza muziki pekee. Mwambie!
achievement.65.name: Rockstar
achievement.66.description: Hakika una njia zako linapokuja suala la kupata pesa. Mengi yao ni ya waridi na yamepambwa kwa vipande vilivyovunjika vya porcelaini.
achievement.66.name: Mtoza posho
achievement.67.description: Upepo kwenye nywele zako, vidole vyako vikishika ukingo wa zulia lako - ndivyo unavyopenda kusafiri. Haraka zaidi! Juu zaidi! Na kitanzi kila mara.
achievement.67.name: Kipeperushi cha Juu
achievement.68.description: Unapenda kupata mikono yako mvua na uchafu - na kufunikwa na udongo. Mchongo wako bora kabisa wa Brog, Titan mkali ndio kazi yako bora ya kweli.
achievement.68.name: Mpiganaji wa udongo
achievement.69.description: Huenda hujui tena jinsi unavyoonekana - kwa kawaida unapojitazama kwenye kioo, aina fulani ya jini hukutazama nyuma. Kwa upande mwingine - labda hiyo ni uboreshaji?
achievement.69.name: Masquerader
achievement.70.description: Chini ya bahari - inaweza kuwa sio nafasi yako ya asili ya kuishi, lakini unajisikia vizuri kwenye sakafu ya bahari. Quara haikuogopi tena na wakati mwingine unalala na kofia yako ya kilindi bado ina vifaa.
achievement.70.name: Diver ya Bahari ya kina
achievement.71.description: Kukimbia bila viatu kwenye makaa si kwa ajili yako! Unafanya kwa njia ya kifahari. Walakini, unavutiwa na moto na mazingira ya joto kwa ujumla - unapenda joto!
achievement.71.name: Firewalker
achievement.72.description: Ah, harufu ya bahari! Kusimama ufukweni na kupiga mstari ni mojawapo ya shughuli unazopenda. Kwa ajili yenu, uvuvi ni kufurahi - na wakati huo huo, kutoa chakula rahisi. Kamili!
achievement.72.name: Hapa, Fishy Fishy!
achievement.73.description: Ikiwa mtu atakupa mbegu, kwa kawaida hukua mmea mzuri kutoka kwake ndani ya siku chache. Unapenda nyumba yako ya kijani na iliyopambwa kwa maua. Labda pia unazungumza nao.
achievement.73.name: Kidole cha Kijani
achievement.74.description: Mfanyabiashara wa uchawi wa eneo lako anakuchukulia kuwa mmoja wa wateja wake bora - kwa kawaida hununua hifadhi kubwa ya dawa ili usiamke katikati ya usiku ukitamani zaidi. Walakini, kila wakati unaonekana kuzikimbia haraka sana. Hongera!
achievement.74.name: Dawa ya kulevya
achievement.75.description: Unapenda kubarizi katika mazingira ya baridi na kuzingatia barafu kuwa nyenzo bora zaidi ya kuunda. Ni upotevu ulioje kutumia vipande vya barafu kwa vinywaji wakati unaweza kuunda sanamu nzuri ya mammoth kutoka kwayo!
achievement.75.name: Mchongaji wa Barafu
achievement.76.description: Nyumba yako ni ngome yako - na samani ndani yake ni muhimu tu. Marafiki wako wanaomba ushauri wako wakati wa kupamba nyumba zao na labda unamiliki kila sanamu, rack na kitanda kilichopo.
achievement.76.name: Mpambaji wa Mambo ya Ndani
achievement.77.description: Wakati mwingine unahisi kuna gremlin huko. Tikiti nyingi za bahati nasibu, nafasi nyingi? Hiyo sio haki! Shiriki taabu zako na ulimwengu.
achievement.77.name: Jinx
achievement.78.description: Hiyo ni karibu bahati sana kwa mtu mmoja. Ikiwa kitu ni cha nadra sana - labda kitaanguka kwenye paja lako mapema au baadaye. Hongera!
achievement.78.name: Shetani mwenye bahati
achievement.79.description: Wewe ni mchongaji sanamu wa marumaru na ustadi mzuri - iliyothibitishwa na sanamu ndogo kamili ya Tibiasula uliyounda. Siku moja utakuwa maarufu sana!
achievement.79.name: Marblelous
achievement.80.description: Mungu wangu, ni paaaaaaaaaaaaarty! Uko kwenye burudani kila wakati, marafiki na pombe na unapenda kuwa kitovu cha umakini. Kuna sababu nyingi za kusherehekea! Woohoo!
achievement.80.name: Mnyama wa Chama
achievement.81.description: Unapenda muda kabla ya roketi yako kupaa na kulipuka na kuwa rangi maridadi - si tu mkesha wa mwaka mpya!
achievement.81.name: Fataki Angani
achievement.82.description: Kuna ... ni ... kwa urahisi ... hapana ... bora ... njia - kuliko kusafiri nyuma ya kobe. Angalau unaweza kupata kufurahia mazingira mazuri ya Laguna.
achievement.82.name: Haraka kama Kobe
achievement.83.description: Ukiona kitu chenye kutu, huwezi kukinza kukisafisha. Daima kuna chupa ndogo ya kiondoa kutu katika orodha yako - ni nani anayejua, kunaweza kuwa na siraha ya dhahabu chini ya uchafu wote huo!
achievement.83.name: Kipolishi
achievement.84.description: Labda hujawahi kuugua bahari maishani mwako - unapenda kutumia wakati wako wa bure kwenye bahari na ulisafiri maili nyingi na meli. Je, hufurahi kwamba haukuhitaji kuogelea yote hayo?
achievement.84.name: Kobold ya meli
achievement.85.description: Kusafiri na boti ndogo za mvuke kupitia mito ya chini ya ardhi ni njia unayopendelea ya kuvuka ardhi. Hakuna seagulls, na bia nzuri kwenye bodi!
achievement.85.name: Steampunked
achievement.86.description: Je, wewe si mrembo tu kikamilifu, ajabu, mrembo? Hauwezi kupitisha kioo bila kupendeza sura yako. Au labda uangalie haraka ikiwa kuna kitu kimekwama kwenye meno yako, labda?
achievement.86.name: Ubatili
achievement.87.description: Watabiri na wapiga ramli hukuongoza katika maisha yako. Na labda haungethubutu kwenda kuwinda wanyama wengi bila fuvu lako la kuaminika la voodoo kukupa idhini yake kwa siku hiyo.
achievement.87.name: Ushirikina
achievement.88.description: Ulitumikia Yalahar - lakini haukuonekana kuwa na uhakika ni nani wa kumwamini njiani. Azerus na Palimuth walikuwa na sababu nzuri za vitendo vyao, na kwa hivyo ulifuata silika yako ya utumbo mwishowe, hata kama ulisaidia yoyote kati yao. Mei Yalahar ifanikiwe!
achievement.88.name: Turncoat
achievement.89.description: Sanamu zako ndogo za Tibiasula zimekuwa maarufu karibu na Tibia na kuna watu wachache walio na ujuzi sawa linapokuja suala la kuunda marumaru.
achievement.89.name: Wazimu wa Marumaru
achievement.90.description: Uchongaji Brog, Titan mkali, ni shauku yako ya siri. Sanamu nyingi za udongo zilizo na jina lako zinaweza kupatikana kila mahali karibu na Tibia.
achievement.90.name: Clay kwa Umaarufu
achievement.91.description: Chukua mchemraba wa barafu na kisu cha obsidian na kuna uwezekano mkubwa utaunda kitu kizuri sana kutoka humo. Mara nyingi mamalia wadogo warembo, ambao wanapendwa na wasichana wote.
achievement.91.name: Baridi kama Barafu
achievement.92.description: Unapenda samaki - lakini ikiwezekana wale waliokamatwa kwenye baridi kaskazini. Ingawa ni vigumu kuzipata, huchoki kamwe kuokota mashimo kwenye karatasi za barafu na kuning'iniza fimbo yako ya uvuvi.
achievement.92.name: Ladha Iliyopendeza
achievement.93.description: Linapokuja suala la uelewa wa watu wa rangi tofauti, wewe ni mtaalamu. Umeijua lugha ya Wachakoya na kumfurahisha mtu kwa ukarimu wako. Achuq!
achievement.93.name: Jamjam
achievement.94.description: Ulimwengu wako una bahati kuwa na wewe! Husiti kuruka na kusaidia wakati mashujaa shujaa wanaitwa kuokoa ulimwengu.
achievement.94.name: Nilifanya Sehemu Yangu
achievement.95.description: Uko mstari wa mbele linapokuja suala la kuokoa ulimwengu wako au kushiriki katika hafla za kijamii. Iwe unaifanya kwa kutambuliwa au kutotambuliwa na watu, ulimwengu wako unaweza kukutegemea wewe kufanya sehemu yako ili kuifanya iwe mahali pazuri kwa kila mtu.
achievement.95.name: Sifa mbaya ya Worldsaver
achievement.96.description: Hujioni kuwa mzuri sana kufanya kazi hiyo chafu huku mtu mwingine akishinda tuzo kwa kumuua Devovorga. Hawangeweza kufanya bila wewe!
achievement.96.name: Mchezaji wa timu
achievement.97.description: Umeingia kwenye uwanja wa Devovorga na kujiunga na wafanyakazi kujaribu kumshusha - iwe umetawazwa na mafanikio au la haijalishi, lakini hawawezi kukulaumu kwa kutojaribu!
achievement.97.name: Kuthubutu Trespasser
achievement.98.description: Nafsi ni kama vipepeo. Nafsi nyeusi ya silaha hai inayotamani kupiga imevunjwa chini ya miguu yako.
achievement.98.name: Muuaji wa Anmothra
achievement.99.description: Nguvu iko katika mapenzi ya yule anayeiamuru. Ulipigana kwa nguvu kamili - na ulikuwa na nguvu zaidi.
achievement.99.name: Muuaji wa Chikhaton
achievement.100.description: Vitu vichache ni sawa na hasira kali ya kiumbe aliyenaswa na aliyevurugwa. Ulikuwa mpinzani anayestahili.
achievement.100.name: Muuaji wa Irahsae
achievement.101.description: Chuki kipofu ilichukua sura ya kimwili, ikiasi kwa jeuri dhidi ya udhalimu uliozaliwa ndani yake. Hukuweza kuleta haki - lakini angalau amani ya muda.
achievement.101.name: Muuaji wa Phrodomo
achievement.102.description: Ujuzi uliokatazwa wa eons haukukusudiwa kamwe kuivamia ulimwengu huu. Ulinyamazisha sauti yake kabla ya kusikika.
achievement.102.name: Muuaji wa Teneshpar
achievement.103.description: Ulisaidia kuleta hema hatari za Devovorga na kifuko chake cha ucheshi chini - bila kusimamisha mabadiliko yake, lakini hatimaye kukamilisha hatua muhimu ya kifo chake.
achievement.103.name: Cocoon of Doom
achievement.104.description: Shujaa mmoja maalum kati ya wengi. Mwaka huu - ilikuwa wewe. Devovorga alijiondoa katika ulimwengu wa giza kwa sababu hakuweza kuhimili nguvu zako - na za wenzi wako. Muda utaonyesha ikiwa chaguo ulilofanya lilikuwa zuri - lakini kwa sasa, liliokoa ulimwengu wako.
achievement.104.name: Devovorga's Nemesis
achievement.105.description: Umechoka... nimechoka sana... kujikunja kwenye kitanda chenye joto na laini inaonekana kuwa jambo bora kufanya hivi sasa. Ndoto tamu!
achievement.105.name: Bwana Sandman
achievement.106.description: Kulala - unafanya kwa mtindo. Unatulia kwenye chandarua chako, ukisikiliza sauti ya ndege na kriketi huku ukipeperushwa polepole hadi kwenye ulimwengu wa ndoto.
achievement.106.name: Nitishe Nilale
achievement.107.description: Huhitaji sana kulala kwa raha. Rundo la majani na paa juu ya kichwa chako - na la pili likiwa ni chaguo kabisa - inatosha kabisa kupumzika. Hujali hata panya kunyonya vidole vyako.
achievement.107.name: Mgeni Mwema
achievement.108.description: Kweli - yaliyomo kwenye zawadi hiyo hayakuwa vile ulivyotarajia. Na marafiki kama hawa, ni nani anayehitaji maadui?
achievement.108.name: Utani unakuhusu
achievement.109.description: Sana kwa rafiki yako mdogo mwenye manyoya! Labda amesimama mbele ya ngome ya ndege, akiminya shingo yake na kupiga kelele 'Imba! Imba! Imba!' ilikuwa kidogo sana kwa hilo?!
achievement.109.name: Lo!
achievement.110.description: Unaishi maisha ya wawindaji na wakusanyaji. Kweli, haswa ile ya mkusanyaji, na haswa yule anayekusanya matunda mengi ya blueberries. Je, umeangalia rangi ya ulimi wako hivi majuzi?
achievement.110.name: Bluebarian
achievement.111.description: Nene, nyekundu - iliyotikiswa, isiyochochewa - na yenye majani ndani yake: ndivyo unavyopendelea damu yako ya pepo. Inatumiwa na pete ya vitunguu, ladha ya hila ya metali ni karibu haionekani. Athari za manufaa kwa afya au mana zinakaribishwa.
achievement.111.name: Mlinda baa mwenye Pepo
achievement.112.description: Unapenda majira ya baridi. Ukiwa na skafu na glavu kikamilifu, unapenda kufurahiya nje huku ukijenga watu wengi wanaotembea kwa theluji na marafiki zako. Mapigano ya mpira wa theluji, mtu yeyote?
achievement.112.name: Mtu wa theluji
achievement.113.name: Idadi ya Mnyama
achievement.114.description: Wewe na marafiki zako wenye manyoya waliojaa vitu hamwezi kutenganishwa, na huoni aibu kuwapeleka kitandani pamoja nawe - ni nani anayejua ni lini utaamka katikati ya usiku ukiwa na haja kubwa ya kubembelezwa?
achievement.114.name: Nahitaji Kukumbatiwa
achievement.115.description: Sawa, tukubaliane nayo - mradi unaamini kwamba inaweza kukuongoza kwenye hazina kubwa zaidi kuwahi kutokea, hutaiacha ramani hiyo, hata kama inaweza kuonekana kuwa ya kuvutia. Lazima kuna siri nyuma ya haya yote!
achievement.115.name: Nafasi Nyembamba
achievement.116.description: Labda wewe si mwanafunzi wa haraka au unapata raha ya kujichoma moto. Au unatafuta tu jina la kifahari. Kwa hali yoyote, unapaswa kujua kwamba kupitisha gesi wakati wa majaribio yako ya punda ndogo haipendekezi.
achievement.116.name: Roketi katika Pocket
achievement.117.description: Lakini funga macho yako na usimwambie mtu yeyote kile ulichotaka, au haitatimia!
achievement.117.name: Fanya Tamaa
achievement.118.description: Krismasi ni wakati unaopenda zaidi wa mwaka, na kijana, unapenda zawadi. Wanunulie marafiki zako vitu vizuri, vifiche hadi - vema, hadi uamue kuvifunua badala yake wewe mwenyewe.
achievement.118.name: Msaidizi wa Li'l wa Santa
achievement.119.description: Hasira ya Spawn ya Noxious - uliweza kuipata kwa bahati mbaya. Siku zako zimehesabiwa na kifo chako hakiepukiki. Wakati fulani. Mahali fulani.
achievement.119.name: Cursed!
achievement.120.description: Ndio! Watafutaji washikaji, waliopotea walia! Ni nani anayejali vitu hivyo vyote vilitoka wapi na ikiwa ilibidi utambae kupitia marundo ya taka ili kuvipata? Ni BURE!
achievement.120.name: Vipengee vya Bure!
achievement.121.description: Juu na chini na juu na chini ... na kisha kitanzi kikubwa! Subiri - hawajengi vitanzi huko Kazordoon. Lakini upandaji wa gari la ore bado unafurahisha!
achievement.121.name: Rollercoaster
achievement.122.description: Wewe, Bwana au Bibi, ni alchemist wa kweli. Kufanya majaribio ya kubadilisha ili kupata kila mchanganyiko unaowezekana imekuwa shauku yako ya siri tangu miaka mingi na matokeo ya utafiti wako ni ya ajabu. Sayansi imechukua hatua kubwa hivi punde!
achievement.122.name: Transmutator
achievement.123.description: RAWR! Nguvu inapita kwenye mwili wako, moyo wako unaenda mbio haraka na adrenaline ikichochea kila aina ya silaha yako. Yote kwenye chupa kidogo. Hakuna kurejeshewa kwa samani zilizoharibiwa. Kwa maswali zaidi wasiliana na mganga wako au muuza madawa ya kulevya.
achievement.123.name: Berserker
achievement.124.description: Unahisi unaweza kutatua mafumbo magumu zaidi ndani ya dakika moja au zaidi. Zaidi ya hayo, kuna uboreshaji mzuri kwenye uharibifu wako wa tahajia. Yote kwenye chupa kidogo. Madhara - kujisikia mjinga kidogo. Kwa maswali zaidi wasiliana na mganga wako au muuza madawa ya kulevya.
achievement.124.name: Mwenye akili
achievement.125.description: Kuboresha macho, mishale na bolts kuruka kwa kasi ya mwanga na kuwabana adui zako na uharibifu wa ziada. Yote kwenye chupa kidogo. Hakuna matumizi ya karoti inahitajika. Kwa maswali zaidi wasiliana na mganga wako au muuza madawa ya kulevya.
achievement.125.name: Sharpshooter
achievement.126.description: Urgh! Funga madirisha! Zima jua ukikuza kichwa chake kibaya cha manjano, funga kicheko cha kupasua masikio cha watoto wa jirani yako. Ahhh. Kukumbatia giza tamu na ukimya.
achievement.126.name: Usinisumbue
achievement.127.description: Inuka na uangaze! Ni siku mpya nzuri - fungua madirisha yako, uhisi mwanga wa jua wenye joto, tazama ndege wakiimba kwenye dirisha lako na utunzaji wa mimea yako. Kuna sababu gani ya kutokuwa na furaha?
achievement.127.name: Wacha Jua Liingie
achievement.128.description: Argh! Si sasa! Inakuwaje kwamba zana hizo zenye kazi nyingi hazishindwi wakati unazitumia kwa jambo dogo kama kukamua juisi, lakini zinavuruga wakati unahitaji sana kupanda juu ya eneo la kamba na joka linalopumua moto likikufukuza?
achievement.128.name: Muda Mbaya
achievement.129.description: Unawacheka wasafiri ambao hawajajiandaa waliokwama kwenye nyasi ndefu au kuni za kukimbilia. Au labda unawasaidia. Wanakuita... 'Machete'.
achievement.129.name: Hakuna Kinachoweza Kunizuia
achievement.130.description: Scythe iliruka juu ya bega lako, jua likiwaka mgongoni mwako - wewe ni mkulima moyoni na unapenda kufanya kazi shambani. Au basi tena labda unaunda duru za kupendeza za mazao ili kuwatisha wanaume wenzako.
achievement.130.name: Furaha Mkulima
achievement.131.description: Liberty Bay ndiyo hangout inayofaa kwako na kuvuna miwa ni shughuli ya kustarehesha kabisa. Je, ungependa chai na sukari yako, mheshimiwa?
achievement.131.name: Utamu wa Asili
achievement.132.description: Yo-ho-ho na chupa ya ramu - iliyotengenezwa nyumbani, bila shaka, iliyofanywa kutoka kwa mimea ya miwa iliyochaguliwa kwa mikono na ya kibinafsi. Sasa, acha izeeke kwenye pipa la mwaloni na ufurahie baada ya miaka 10. Au kwa wale wasio na subira: Wacha tufanye sherehe sasa hivi!
achievement.132.name: Homebrewed
achievement.133.description: Hazina zilizofichwa chini ya matuta ya mchanga wa jangwa - una pua ya kuzipata na unajua wapi kuchimba. Huenda zisikufanye kuwa tajiri mchafu, lakini zinang'aa na nzuri hata hivyo.
achievement.133.name: Gold Digger
achievement.134.description: Wewe na koleo lako - mechi iliyofanywa mbinguni. Au kuzimu, kwa jambo hilo. Mahali pengine chini kwa hali yoyote. Unavutiwa kichawi na milundo ya mawe na unapenda kuzifungua na kuona ni wapi mashimo hayo yanakupeleka. Biceps nzuri pia.
achievement.134.name: Mzishi
achievement.135.description: Unaweza kupatikana kwa urahisi na mtu yeyote ikiwa atafuata tu njia ya makombo ya kuki. Na kwako, upendo wa kweli unamaanisha kutoa kuki yako ya mwisho.
achievement.135.name: Kuki Monster
achievement.136.description: Na yeyote anayedai vinginevyo ni mwongo.
achievement.136.name: Keki ni Ukweli
achievement.137.description: Huenda kitabu maarufu cha 'Ode to a Molten Chocolate Cake' kiliandikwa na wewe. Kutumia alasiri ya mvua mbele ya bomba la moshi, ukiwa umefunikwa kwa blanketi huku ukijifurahisha kwa kakao kunasikika kama kitu ambacho ungefanya. Furahia!
achievement.137.name: Jino Tamu
achievement.138.description: Unapenda keki yako laini, na vipande vya matunda na icing nzuri ya sukari. Na unapendelea kuwafanya peke yako. Je, umewahi kufikiria kufungua duka la mikate? Lazima uwe mzuri sana sasa!
achievement.138.name: Na Cherry Juu
achievement.139.description: Muahhaha ni... mutated pumpkin! Baada ya kusaidia kuiondoa - ULISAIDIA, sivyo? - ulidai thawabu yako na ukapata zawadi ya kushangaza zaidi au kidogo. Furaha ya Halloween!
achievement.139.name: Mutated Presents
achievement.140.description: Mmoja wa Lightbearers. Mmoja wa wale waliosaidia kuweka mabeseni kuwaka na kufanya kazi pamoja dhidi ya giza. Minong'ono ya pepo nyuma ya pazia nyembamba kati ya walimwengu - walinyamazishwa tena kwa msaada wako.
achievement.140.name: Mlinzi wa Moto
achievement.141.description: Wewe ni mmoja wa Lightbearers waliojitolea zaidi - bila wewe, mapepo yangepasua pazia kati ya walimwengu bila shaka. Umewasha kila beseni, ukisafiri juu na chini, ukirudisha nyuma nguvu za ulimwengu mwingine. Hebu iwe na mwanga!
achievement.141.name: Kweli Lightbearer
achievement.142.description: Umeshinda mwili wa Mungu wa Nyoka na, kwa swing ya mwisho yenye nguvu ya fimbo ya enzi ya nyoka, ulikata usambazaji wake wa nguvu ya maisha. Hadithi ya mamlaka, udanganyifu na ufisadi imefikia mwisho - au ... sivyo?
achievement.142.name: Godslayer
achievement.143.description: Uhm... ni mtu gani huyo ambaye umeamka kando yake? Miwani ya cocktail iliyovunjika kwenye sakafu, maua kwenye chumba, na kwa nini umevaa pete? Jana lazima iwe ilikuwa siku ndefu, ya kushangaza ...
achievement.143.name: Siku Baada Ya
achievement.144.description: Mahusiano ya muda mrefu sio kwako tu. Na kila wakati unapofikiri uko katika mapenzi, unathibitishwa kuwa umekosea muda mfupi baadaye. Au labda unaishia tu na mpenzi mbaya kila wakati - kunyonywa na kusalitiwa. Kukaa bila kuolewa kunaweza kuwa bora zaidi.
achievement.144.name: Kujitolea Phobic
achievement.145.description: Je, unaamini? Upendo? Uaminifu? Pah! Hisia za zamani. Kwa muda mrefu kama unafurahiya, haujali kukanyaga mioyo mingi. Ikiwezekana wakati wa kuvaa buti za mapigano.
achievement.145.name: Mvunja moyo
achievement.146.description: Stealth unaua na backstabbing ni wewe maalum. Wahasiriwa wako wengi kwa kawaida hawajui kifo chao kinachokaribia, ambacho unawaletea kimya na haraka. Kila kitu kinaruhusiwa.
achievement.146.name: Kifo cha Mwepesi
achievement.147.description: Ni nini bora maishani? Kuponda adui zako. Kuwaona wakiendeshwa mbele yako. Na labda kuwa na kikombe kizuri cha chai baadaye.
achievement.147.name: Adabu ya Kikatili
achievement.148.description: Wewe ni mwombaji, huna makazi, umevaa nguo chafu na chakavu. Lakini hiyo haimaanishi kwamba unapaswa kuomba mtu yeyote kwa ajili ya mambo - na bado ulihifadhi kiburi chako. Manyoya nzuri si lazima kufanya ndege nzuri - ni nini chini yao ni muhimu zaidi.
achievement.148.name: Maisha ya Mtaani
achievement.149.description: Ukiwa umevaa nembo na mavazi meusi ya Udugu wa Mifupa unazurura katika nchi ukieneza hofu na maumivu, ukitengeneza askari wapya kwa ajili ya jeshi la necromantic ambalo linakaribia kuinuka hivi karibuni. Salamu Udugu.
achievement.149.name: Fuvu na Mifupa
achievement.150.description: Huogopi jinamizi, unasafiri ndani yake - unakabiliwa na vitisho vingi na kupigana na hatima wanayokaribia kuleta. Ni wachache wanaoamini unabii mbaya unaoleta kutoka kwa ndoto hizo, lakini wale wanaopigana pamoja nawe kama Nightmare Knights.
achievement.150.name: Mtembezi wa Ndoto
achievement.151.description: Kila jiji linapaswa kujivunia kumwita mtu kama wewe mkaaji wake. Unaweka barabara safi na kusaidia kusuluhisha mizozo ya kawaida mbele ya bohari. Pia, labda unamiliki paka na unapenda kupanda mlima.
achievement.151.name: Mwananchi wa Mfano
achievement.152.description: Hubebi hisa hiyo kwa ajili ya mapambo tu - uko tayari kuitumia. Kwa kawaida unaonekana ukiruka juu kwenye shimo lenye kina kirefu zaidi ukiacha msururu wa pepo waliouawa. Yeyote atakayethubutu kusimama katika njia yako ajiandae kufa.
achievement.152.name: Demonbane
achievement.153.description: Moja na asili, moja na wanyamapori. Nguvu mbichi na ya mnyama, hisia kali, kulia kwenye miamba ya juu na kunguruma kwenye misitu minene - ni wewe.
achievement.153.name: Ya Mbwa Mwitu na Dubu
achievement.154.description: Wakati wa mchana unaweza kupatikana umejificha msituni ukiweka mitego au ukifuata wanyama wakubwa, usiku umeketi kando ya moto na kushiriki hadithi zako za uwindaji. Unakula ulichowinda na kuvaa ulichochuna. Maisha yanaweza kuendelea hivyo milele.
achievement.154.name: Uwindaji kwa Sinema
achievement.155.description: Na kumbuka: Usijaribu kamwe kufundisha nguruwe kuimba. Inapoteza muda wako na inakera nguruwe.
achievement.155.name: Mpumbavu Moyoni
achievement.156.description: Ukiwa na makali yenye makali na ukiwa na silaha kamili ya sahani, unawashambulia adui zako kwa nguvu na ushujaa. Daima kuna msichana wa kuokoa na joka kuua kwa ajili yako.
achievement.156.name: Katika Silaha za Kuangaza
achievement.157.description: Unaanza siku yako kwa kuoga kwenye sufuria yako ya dhahabu na haujali kuonyesha utajiri wako wakati unatembea barabarani umevaa nguo zako bora - baada ya yote ni pesa zako ulizochuma kwa bidii! Unapendelea kushughulikiwa na 'Mtukufu wako'.
achievement.157.name: Aristocrat
achievement.158.description: Marundo ya theluji na mvua ya mawe haviwezi kukuzuia kutoka unapotaka kwenda. Umejitayarisha kikamilifu kwa safari yoyote katika barafu ya kudumu na unajua jinsi ya kuweka miguu yako joto. Ikiwa wewe ni mwanamke, hiyo ni mafanikio makubwa, pia.
achievement.158.name: Nje katika Dhoruba ya theluji
achievement.159.description: Unajisikia nyumbani chini ya jua kali la jangwa na mchanga kati ya vidole vyako, na njia unayopenda ya kusafiri ni carpet ya kuruka. Pia, pengine unaweza kufanya hoja hiyo ya densi ya kutengwa na kichwa.
achievement.159.name: Elfu Moja na Moja
achievement.160.description: Nyinyi kuwa muungwana o 'bahati, fightin' na carousin' juu ya bahari kuu, nje fer ngawira na lassies! Nyinyi msiwe na jibu kwa mtu yeyote au ufalme uliolipuliwa na maisha si ya lily-livered. Ndio, jamaa!
achievement.160.name: Swashbuckler
achievement.161.description: Kutikisa njuga yako na kucheza karibu na moto kwa ngoma za msituni kunasikika kama kitu unachopenda kufanya. Mbali na hilo, dreadlocks ni njia rahisi ya kuvaa nywele zako - hakuna kuchanganya inahitajika!
achievement.161.name: Njia ya Shaman
achievement.162.description: Unaweza kuwa mwandishi wa opus kubwa 'Jinsi ya Kumwita Mnyama wa Mwisho kutoka kwa kina cha Infernal, Juzuu ya I'. Au, ikiwa akili na moyo wako ni safi, afadhali uwaite viumbe kusaidia wengine. Au labda paka mdogo tu kuwa na mtu wa kubembeleza.
achievement.162.name: Ritualist
achievement.163.description: Huogopi kuonyesha rangi zako kwenye joto la vita. Maadui wanaogopa mkuki wako mbaya na silaha zisizoweza kupenyeka. Orodha ya vita ambavyo umeshinda ni ya kuvutia. Salamu na kuua!
achievement.163.name: Mwalimu wa Vita
achievement.164.description: Ushujaa ni kwa wanyonge - haijalishi jinsi unavyoshinda vita, mradi tu wewe ni mshindi. Silaha nene zinaweza kuzuia harakati zako, kwa hivyo unaifanya iwe nyepesi na unategemea kasi na ujuzi badala ya kujificha kwenye ganda lisilofaa.
achievement.164.name: Wild Warrior
achievement.165.description: Wewe ni shujaa mnyenyekevu ambaye hauhitaji mali au vifaa maalum kwa kusafiri na kupigana. Unajisikia uko nyumbani katika ardhi ya kaskazini ya Zao na ulifanya sehemu yako katika kupambana na ufisadi wake.
achievement.165.name: Peazzekeeper
achievement.166.description: Matendo yako kwa Yalahar kawaida yana sifa ya utambuzi wa kina na vitendo vya kufikiria. Asante kwako, Yalahar anaweza kuwa na nafasi ya kukua kwa amani na watu wenye furaha wanaoishi humo.
achievement.166.name: Yalahari ya Hekima
achievement.167.description: Unatetea Yalahar kwa nguvu ya kikatili na uko tayari kuiongoza kwenye vita vitukufu, ikiwa ni lazima. Shukrani kwako, Yalahar itakuwa na nguvu ya kutosha kusimama dhidi ya adui yeyote.
achievement.167.name: Yalahari ya Nguvu
achievement.168.description: Maisha yanaweza kuwa rahisi sana na keki inayofaa kwa wakati unaofaa - na umejua kuoka nyingi tofauti, kwa hivyo unapaswa kuwa tayari kwa karibu kila kitu ambacho maisha huamua kukutupa.
achievement.168.name: Kipande cha Keki
achievement.169.description: Unachukuliwa kuwa mhitimu wa daraja la kwanza katika Chuo cha Uchawi huko Edron kutokana na uvumbuzi wako wa awali na masomo yenye mafanikio katika nyanja ya majaribio ya uchawi na ukuzaji tahajia. Umewahi kufikiria kufundisha spell ya Har–Magedoni?
achievement.169.name: Alumni
achievement.170.description: Wewe ni mjuzi katika njia nyeusi za uchawi na kwa kawaida hupatikana ukiwa umeketi ndani ya duara la mishumaa na mafuvu yakinung'unika maneno yasiyosemeka. Usibebe vitu mbali sana au pepo wanaweza kuja kukuchukua.
achievement.170.name: Warlock
achievement.171.description: Hakika, una doa laini kwa sungura. Labda sungura uliowahifadhi leo watakuwa sungura ambao watakuokoa kesho. Wakati una njaa kweli.
achievement.171.name: Sungura Ameteleza
achievement.172.description: Wanasayansi wa kweli wanajua vifaa vyao. Kujaribu uvumbuzi mpya ni kazi muhimu ya kila siku kwa mtafiti yeyote anayefanya kazi kwa bidii. Hukuonyesha woga na ulichukua vifaa vyote vipya kutoka kwa Spectulus na Sinclair kwa spin.
achievement.172.name: Nguruwe wa Guinea
achievement.173.description: Uliingia msituni, ukakutana na Rottin Wood na Wanaume Walioolewa na ukawasaidia katika kambi yao. Lo, na usijali kuhusu wafanyabiashara hao. Hawatathubutu kutaja kiasi kikubwa cha ajabu cha dhahabu walichokuwa nacho ambacho hakipo sasa.
achievement.173.name: Merry Adventures
achievement.174.description: Ulifaulu mtihani wao na kusaidia vifaa vya upimaji vya Spirithunters, kutafiti juu ya miujiza na kupata vizuka - ni wewe watakupigia simu.
achievement.174.name: Haogopi Roho!
achievement.175.description: Takriban mimea yote uliyoifanyia majaribio Chartan huko Zao ambapo haiwezi kuliwa - uliionja yote, lakini bado umesimama! Unapaswa kupata hewa safi sasa, ingawa.
achievement.175.name: Extreme Degustation
achievement.176.description: Umeingia kwa ujasiri kwenye kisiwa cha keki. Je, kuna mahali pengine pazuri na pazuri pa kuwa ulimwenguni kote?
achievement.176.name: Mshindi wa Keki
achievement.177.description: Umemchangamsha mtoto wa pepo na kumrudishia mama yake. Hesabu ya haraka ya vidole vyako itadhihirisha ikiwa umefanikiwa bila kudhurika.
achievement.177.name: Mtoto Mlezi
achievement.178.description: Umechangamsha kundi la watoto wachanga wa mapepo na kuwarudisha kwa mama yao. Usisumbue alama za kuchoma, usisumbue shida za nywele za kijivu, usisumbue usiku unapoamka kupiga kelele. Ilikuwa na thamani yake ... pengine ... kwa namna fulani.
achievement.178.name: Nanny kutoka Kuzimu
achievement.179.description: Umesafiri bahari ya chini na Ghost Captain. Licha ya hatari, wewe na wafanyakazi wenzako mmeshinda changamoto.
achievement.179.name: Ghost Sailor
achievement.180.description: Umesafiri bahari ya chini na Ghost Captain mara kadhaa. Hatari za watu wa chini zimejulikana kwako na wasafiri wasio na uzoefu wanakugeukia kwa ushauri.
achievement.180.name: Msafiri wa Spectral
achievement.181.description: Bila kuogopa kifo au mizimu umesafiri na nahodha wa roho mara kadhaa na wewe ni msafiri mwenye uzoefu wa ulimwengu wa wafu. Wafu na walio hai wananong'ona juu ya ushujaa wako kwa shukrani.
achievement.181.name: Nether Pirate
achievement.182.description: Wewe ni bwana wa bahari ya chini na umesafiri na nahodha wa roho mara nyingi sana kwamba unajua meli yake na hatari za bahari ya chini ndani nje. Unacheka usoni mwa kifo na unaweza kurudi kama maharamia wa roho katika maisha ya baada ya kifo!
achievement.182.name: Janga la Kifo
achievement.183.description: Umesaidia kuwasha moto wachawi. Tazama tu vidole vyako, ni moto!
achievement.183.name: Moto Nyepesi
achievement.184.description: Ulitoa viungo ili kuunda pombe ya kinga ya wachawi.
achievement.184.name: Wachawi Lil' Msaidizi
achievement.185.description: Ulijitolea viungo vingi kuunda pombe ya kinga ya wachawi na ukachukua sehemu kubwa katika juhudi za kuwafukuza waleta machafuko. Kikwazo ni kwamba hata wale wanaoleta mabaya wanaweza kukutambua ...
achievement.185.name: Banebringers' Bane
achievement.186.description: Ili kuweka moto wa wachawi uwaka, ulitupa kuni nyingi zilizohuishwa. Wengine wanaweza kupata hamu yako ya moto ... inasumbua.
achievement.186.name: Fire Devil
achievement.187.description: Upendo ... moto! Hivyo ... shiny! Lazima ... buuuurrrn!
achievement.187.name: Pyromaniac
achievement.188.description: Juhudi zako za kupigana na waleta machafuko hazijaonekana. Wewe ni hadithi miongoni mwa wachawi na jina lako linanong'ona kwa mshangao na pongezi.
achievement.188.name: Mchawi wa heshima
achievement.189.description: Ah, furaha ya kupanda! Unayo mlima wako wa kwanza tu. Kwa urahisi wa kutosha hauitaji hata mazizi, lakini unaweza kuiita wakati wowote upendao.
achievement.189.name: Asili Born Cowboy
achievement.190.description: Mawe yamekuvutia kila wakati. Kwa hivyo ana nafasi ya kupata kitu cha thamani sana ndani ya mmoja wao. Kitakwimu unapaswa kuwa umegundua hazina chache nzuri kwa sasa. Lakini basi tena, takwimu nyingi zimepuuzwa na Mama Msiba.
achievement.190.name: Petrologist
achievement.191.description: Umegundua nguvu zilizofichwa za Wazee - kuanzia sasa na kuendelea, zitakusaidia katika matukio yako.
achievement.191.name: Nguvu Zilizofichwa
achievement.192.description: Hakika unajua jinsi ya kuleta bora katika samani zako na vipande vya mapambo. Mrembo.
achievement.192.name: Naipenda Fancy
achievement.193.description: Unabeba kisu chako cha obsidian kila wakati na hautasita kukitumia. Umechuna ngozi isitoshe - na kubwa zaidi - wakosoaji na ndio: kwa kawaida huwa hawapendezi zaidi ndani. Ni afadhali damu na majivuno na hayo yote ...
achievement.193.name: Ngozi-Kina
achievement.194.description: Staking Vampires na mapepo karibu kugeuka kuwa taaluma yako. Unahakikisha unakusanya hata kiwango kidogo zaidi cha chembe mbaya za vumbi. Jihadharini na silikosisi.
achievement.194.name: Majivu kwa Mavumbi
achievement.196.description: Usijali, hakuna mtu atakayeweza kuichukua kutoka kwako. Pengine.
achievement.196.name: Imehifadhiwa Mbali kwa Usalama
achievement.197.description: Naapa kwa miungu! Hiyo ilikuwa nini?
achievement.197.name: Kitu kiko Humo
achievement.198.description: Awww. Rafiki yako mdogo wa samaki wa dhahabu - ni mzuri, anang'aa na hawezi kulalamika ikiwa ungesahau kumlisha. Hakika ataifurahisha siku yako!
achievement.198.name: Mnyama Mnyama
achievement.199.description: Kurukaruka, kuruka-ruka kwenye theluji - hiyo ndiyo njia ya kufurahisha zaidi! Kufanya nyayo kwa mwendo wa kasi - inafurahisha zaidi kadri unavyoharakisha! Kulamba icicles siku nzima - Majira ya baridi, usitoke kamwe!
achievement.199.name: Snowbunny
achievement.200.description: Laana mbaya, uchawi mbaya - huoni aibu kuwaadhibu wengine kwa njia zisizo na shaka. Mtu amekupa sura ya kushangaza - sasa hiyo sindano iko wapi tena?
achievement.200.name: Kuhani wa Voodoo ya Giza
achievement.201.description: Nyumbani ndipo uwanja wako wa uwindaji unaoupenda sasa ulipo, na ingawa unaweza kushikilia maeneo fulani zaidi kuliko mengine hukuwahi kuhisi kushikamana vya kutosha kuweza kukaa katika jiji moja kwa muda mrefu. Pakia vitu vyako vyote - ni wakati wa kuendelea tena.
achievement.201.name: Nafsi ya Nomad
achievement.202.description: Ulimwambia Jack ukweli kwa kueleza wewe na Spectulus alifanya makosa wakati wa kujaribu kumshawishi kuwa mtu tofauti kabisa.
achievement.202.name: Ukweli Usemwe
achievement.203.description: Hukumwambia Jack ukweli kuhusu kosa ambalo wewe na Spectulus mlifanya mlipojaribu kumshawishi kuhusu kuwa mtu tofauti kabisa. Ataishi kwa mashaka hadi mwisho wa kuwepo kwake.
achievement.203.name: Humjui Jack
achievement.204.description: Jumuiya ya Mchanganyiko wa Winterberry ya Kichawi kwa hivyo inaheshimu kuendelea kujitolea na juhudi za ajabu katika Msimu wa Msimu wa Vuli wa Mwaka.
achievement.204.name: Berry picker
achievement.205.description: Wewe na marafiki zako mlionyesha wachawi watatu uaminifu wako mara tatu - nina hakika angalau mmoja wao labda anashukuru milele na anajivunia wewe.
achievement.205.name: Rangi za Kweli
achievement.206.description: Umefaulu changamoto ya Kuriks katika maumbo yote yanayowezekana.
achievement.206.name: Mwalimu Shapeshifter
achievement.207.description: Kwa usaidizi wa msaidizi wako mdogo mwenye urafiki, ulichukua zaidi ya vipande 500 vya lami. Umefanya vizuri, Slimer.
achievement.207.name: Slimer
achievement.208.description: Uliua mage mkali katika mnara wake kusini mwa Zao. Tena. Lakini huyu anaendelea kurudi. Lango la sura liliporomoka tena na unajua atarudi hatimaye lakini jamani - jasiri mkali, ni kama kuuliza...
achievement.208.name: Mageslayer
achievement.209.description: Ulipata waogeleaji hamsini adimu wanaometa. Kutoa maiti hizo zote kwa kuzitupa ziwani kulifaa kweli, sivyo? Subiri, hakuna kitu kilichosogea majini sasa hivi...?
achievement.209.name: Biodegradable
achievement.210.description: Hukuiangalia - angalau si kwa muda mrefu sana ... lakini Groam alifanya. Na ukamtuliza. Usimwambie tu rafiki yake Mlevi.
achievement.210.name: Jicho la Kina
achievement.211.description: Viumbe wengi wa kilindi wamepoteza maisha yao kwa mkono wako. Mia tatu wameingia kwenye vilindi vya umilele. Labda unapaswa kuogopa kisasi cha Macho ya Kina.
achievement.211.name: Mvamizi wa Kina
achievement.212.description: Umezima miiba 500! Ulikuwepo wakati Firestarters ilipochukua Shadowthorn. Uliokoa siku - na nyumba ya elves ambayo itajaribu kukuua hata hivyo. Je, haifurahishi kuona kila kitu kikirejeshwa kama ilivyokuwa hapo awali..?
achievement.212.name: Firefighter
achievement.213.description: Umeweza kuua kulungu zaidi ya mia nne - inaonekana kama wewe ni moja ya sababu kuu ambazo hivi karibuni zitazingatiwa kuwa zimetoweka, njia ya kwenda!
achievement.213.name: Kuwinda Kulungu
achievement.214.description: Sasa wewe ni rafiki wa kifalme wa Askarak, muuaji mkuu.
achievement.214.name: Askarak Nemesis
achievement.215.description: Sasa wewe ni adui mkuu wa umma wa Shaburak, muuaji mkuu.
achievement.215.name: Shaburak Nemesis
achievement.216.description: Ulivunja mtungi wa Horesti mara hamsini. Labda hujui hofu au kupuuza tu. Vyovyote iwavyo, "huna woga" kweli.
achievement.216.name: Bila woga
achievement.217.description: Kuna mtu alimpigia simu daktari? Ulipeleka mifuko 100 ya dawa kwa Ottokar wa nyumba maskini ya Venore wakati wa uhitaji mkubwa, umefanya vizuri!
achievement.217.name: Daktari! Daktari!
achievement.218.description: You significantly helped the afflicted citizens of Venore in times of dire need. Somehow you still feel close to the victims of the fever outbreak. Your clothes make you one of them, one poor soul amongst the countless afflicted.
achievement.218.name: Daktari wa mdomo
achievement.219.description: You vanquished the mad mage, you subdued the raging mage - no spellweaving self-exposer can stand in your way. Yet you are quite absorbed in magical studies yourself. This very fabric reflects this personal approval of the magic arts.
achievement.219.name: Mystic Fabric Magic
achievement.221.description: You've shattered each of Bloodweb's eight frozen legs. As they say: break a leg, and then some more.
achievement.221.name: Arachnoise
achievement.222.description: You've descended into the swampy depths of Deathbine's lair and made quick work of it.
achievement.222.name: Rootless Behaviour
achievement.223.description: You've slain Esmeralda, the most hideous and aggressive of the mutated rats. No one will know that you almost lost a finger in the process.
achievement.223.name: Twisted Mutation
achievement.224.description: Ethershreck's cry of agony kept ringing in your ear for hours after he had dissolved into thin air. He probably moved to another plane of existence... for a while.
achievement.224.name: Beautiful Agony
achievement.225.description: A mighty blaze went out today. It's Flameborn's turn to wait for his rebirth in the eternal cycle of life and death.
achievement.225.name: Scorched Flames
achievement.226.description: You ripped the ancient scarab Fleshcrawler apart and made sure he didn't get under your skin.
achievement.226.name: Crawling Death
achievement.227.description: You made a knot with Gorgo's living curls and took her scalp. You couldn't save her countless petrified victims, but at least you didn't become one.
achievement.227.name: The Serpent's Bride
achievement.228.description: You've found a well-hidden spider queen and caught her off guard in the middle of her meal.
achievement.228.name: No More Hiding
achievement.229.description: It seems the gates to the underworld have to remain unprotected for a while. Kerberos, the mighty hellhound, lost his head. All three of them.
achievement.229.name: The Gates of Hell
achievement.230.description: As the killer of Leviathan, the giant sea serpent, his underwater kingdom is now under your reign.
achievement.230.name: The Drowned Sea God
achievement.231.description: Ribstride is striding no more. He had quite a few ribs to spare though.
achievement.231.name: Spareribs for Dinner
achievement.232.description: You almost made friends with Shardhead... before he died. Poor guy only seems to attract violence with his frosty attitude.
achievement.232.name: Breaking the Ice
achievement.233.description: Stonecracker's head was much softer than the stones he threw at you.
achievement.233.name: Just Cracked Me Up!
achievement.234.description: You've exinguished the Sulphur Scuttler's gas clouds and made the air in his cave a little better... at least for a while.
achievement.234.name: Something Smells
achievement.235.description: You've impaled the big mammoth Bloodtusk with his own tusks.
achievement.235.name: Meat Skewer
achievement.236.description: The Many is no more, but how many more are there? One can never know.
achievement.236.name: One Less
achievement.237.description: You've vanquished the Noxious Spawn and his serpentine heart.
achievement.237.name: Hissing Downfall
achievement.238.description: The Old Widow fell prey to your supreme hunting skills.
achievement.238.name: Choking on Her Venom
achievement.239.description: You've tainted the jungle floor with the Snapper's crimson blood.
achievement.239.name: Blood-Red Snapper
achievement.240.description: You've cut off a whole lot of tentacles today. Thul was driven back to where he belongs.
achievement.240.name: Back into the Abyss
achievement.241.description: You've faced and defeated a lot of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
achievement.241.name: Pwned a Lot of Fur
achievement.242.description: You've stopped the bank robber and returned the bag full of gold. Good to know there are still lawful Tibians like you around.
achievement.242.name: Honest Finder
achievement.243.description: If it wasn't for you, several banks in Tibia would've gotten bankrupt by now. Keep on chasing bank robbers and no one will have to worry about the Tibian economy!
achievement.243.name: Goldhunter
achievement.244.description: You've discovered a trail of giant footprints and terrified elephants running everywhere. Could it be that the mysterious ape god is rambling in the jungle?
achievement.244.name: Trail of the Ape God
achievement.245.description: That was NOT a giant spider. There's some witchcraft at work here.
achievement.245.name: Someone's Bored
achievement.246.description: You can't keep a secret, can you? Then again, you're just fulfilling your duty to the Queen of Carlin as a lawful citizen. That's a good thing, isn't it...?
achievement.246.name: Whistle-Blower
achievement.247.description: Wyda seems to be really, really bored. You also found out that she doesn't really need all those blood herbs that adventurers brought her. Still, she was nice enough to take one from you and gave you something quite cool in exchange.
achievement.247.name: Torn Treasures
achievement.248.description: You joined the Kingsday festivities and payed King Tibianus your respects. Now, off to party!
achievement.248.name: Loyal Subject
achievement.249.description: You managed to catch a fish in a surrounding that usually doesn't even carry water. Everything is subject to change, probably...
achievement.249.name: Desert Fisher
achievement.251.description: You showed Noodles the way home. How long will it take this time until he's on the loose again? That dog must be really bored in the throne room by now.
achievement.251.name: Dog Sitter
achievement.252.description: You witnessed the thawing of Svargrond and harvested rare seeds from some strange icy plants. They must be good for something.
achievement.252.name: Ice Harvester
achievement.253.description: You are a pretty smart thinker and managed to create everlasting flowers. They might become a big hit with all the people who aren't blessed with a green thumb or just forgetful.
achievement.253.name: Preservationist
achievement.254.description: You've discovered three nomad camps and stole their supplies. Well, you can probably use them better then they can.
achievement.254.name: Chest Robber
achievement.255.description: You've found a secret dungeon in the flooded plains and killed several of its inhabitants. And now you have wet feet.
achievement.255.name: Down the Drain
achievement.256.description: You've survived the Hellgorge eruption and found a way through the flames and lava. You've even managed to kill a few fireborn on the way.
achievement.256.name: Fire from the Earth
achievement.257.description: Your actions start to make a difference. You have blinded the antennae of the hive often enough to become an annoyance to it.
achievement.257.name: Minor Disturbance
achievement.258.description: In the war against the hive, your efforts in blinding it begin to pay off. Your actions have blinded the hive severely and the entity seems to become aware that something dangerous is happening.
achievement.258.name: Dazzler
achievement.259.description: You have put a lot of time and energy into keeping the hive unaware of what is happening on Quirefang. The hive learnt to fear your actions. It would surely crush you with all its might ... if it could only find you!
achievement.259.name: Hive Blinder
achievement.260.description: You have grown accustomed to frequenting the hive's stomach system. Your actions have caused the hive some first digestion problems.
achievement.260.name: Hickup
achievement.261.description: Never-tiring, you attack the inner organs of the mighty hive. Your attacks on the hive's digestion system begin to cause some trouble.
achievement.261.name: Heartburn
achievement.262.description: You severely disrupted the digestion of the hive. The hive should for sure see a doctor. It seems you proved to be more than it can swallow.
achievement.262.name: Stomach Ulcer
achievement.263.description: The hive has to be fought with might and main, hampering its soldiers is only the first step. You diligently stopped the pores of the hive to spread its warriors.
achievement.263.name: Planter
achievement.264.description: You are getting more and more experienced in destroying the supply of the enemy's forces. Your actions caused the hive some severe skin problems.
achievement.264.name: Pimple
achievement.265.description: A war is won by those who have the best supply of troops. The hive's troops have been dealt a significant blow by your actions. You interrupted the hive's replenishment of troops lastingly and severely.
achievement.265.name: Suppressor
achievement.266.description: By killing creatures of the hive and gaining weapons for further missions, you started a quite effective way of war. You gathered a lot of dissolved chitin to resupply the war effort.
achievement.266.name: Gatherer
achievement.267.description: The need for supplies often decides over loss or victory. Your tireless efforts to resupply the resources keeps the war against the hive going.
achievement.267.name: Supplier
achievement.268.description: You have become competent and efficient in gathering the substance that is needed to fight the hive. You almost smell like dissolved chitin and the Hive Born would tell their children scary stories about you if they could speak.
achievement.268.name: Chitin Bane
achievement.269.description: You have proven that you can beat the best of the hive. You have caused first promising breaches in the defence of the hive
achievement.269.name: Guard Killer
achievement.270.description: The most powerful warriors of the hive were killed by you by the dozens. The hive is not safe anymore because of your actions.
achievement.270.name: Hive Infiltrator
achievement.271.description: Efficient and lethal, you have gained significant experience in fighting the elite forces of the hive. Almost single-handed, you have slain the best of the Hive Born and live to tell the tale.
achievement.271.name: Exterminator
achievement.272.description: Even in the deepest structures of the hive, you began to strike against the mighty foe. Your actions probably already gave the hive a headache.
achievement.272.name: Headache
achievement.273.description: The destruction you have caused by now can be felt throughout the whole hive. The mayhem that follows your step caused significant confusion in the consciousness of the hive.
achievement.273.name: Confusion
achievement.274.description: You have destroyed a significant amount of the hive's vital nerve centers and caused massive destruction to the hive's awareness. You are probably causing the hive horrible nightmares.
achievement.274.name: Manic
achievement.276.name: Navigational Error
achievement.277.description: You've found the oriental traveller Yasir and were able to trade with him - even if you didn't really understand his language.
achievement.277.name: Si, Ariki!
achievement.278.description: You ended the life of over three hundred Deepling Guards. Not quite the guardian of the Deeplings, are you?
achievement.278.name: Guardian Downfall
achievement.279.description: You hushed the songs of war in the black depths by sliencing more than three hundred Deepling Spellsingers.
achievement.279.name: Death Song
achievement.280.description: By eliminating at least three hundred Deepling Warriors you delivered quite a blow to the amassing armies of the deep.
achievement.280.name: Depth Dwellers
achievement.281.description: You cut your first gem - and it bears your own name! Now that would be a nice gift! This does not make it a "true" Heart of the Sea, however...
achievement.281.name: Gem Cutter
achievement.282.description: You travelled the depths of this very world. You entered the blackness of the deep sea to conquer the realm of the Deeplings. May this suit remind you of the strange beauty below.
achievement.282.name: Spolium Profundis
achievement.283.description: Countless fights and never tiring effort in the war against the hive grant you the experience to finish your outfit with the last remaining part. Your chitin outfit is a testament of your skills and dedication for the cause.
achievement.283.name: Bane of the Hive
achievement.285.description: Your invaluable experience in fighting the hive allows you to add another piece of armor to your chitin outfit to prove your dedication for the cause.
achievement.285.name: Hive War Veteran
achievement.286.description: You have participated that much in the hive war, that you are able to create some makeshift armor from the remains of dead hive born that can be found in the major hive, to show of your skill.
achievement.286.name: Hive Fighter
achievement.287.description: You muted the everlasting howling of Hemming.
achievement.287.name: Howly Silence
achievement.288.description: No more fear and bad dreams. You stabbed Tormentor to death with its scythe leg.
achievement.288.name: Dream's Over
achievement.289.description: You wiped Fazzrah away - zzeemzz like now you're the captain.
achievement.289.name: Zzztill Zzztanding!
achievement.290.description: This time you knocked out the big one.
achievement.290.name: Stepped on a Big Toe
achievement.291.description: No joke, you murdered the bat.
achievement.291.name: Kapow!
achievement.292.description: You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
achievement.292.name: Enter zze Draken!
achievement.293.description: Bretzecutioner's body just got slammed away. You are a true king of the ring!
achievement.293.name: King of the Ring
achievement.294.description: You overcame the undead Zanakeph and sent him back into the darkness that spawned him.
achievement.294.name: Back from the Dead
achievement.295.description: You've faced and defeated each of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
achievement.295.name: Pwned All Fur
achievement.297.description: You lend a helping hand in defeating invading Orcs by destroying their warcamp along with their leader. Bibby's personal bloodbath...
achievement.297.name: Bibby's Bloodbath
achievement.298.description: You cleansed the land from an eight legged nuisance by defeating Mamma Longlegs three times. She won't be back soon... or will she?
achievement.298.name: Nestling
achievement.299.description: You did it! You convinced the reclusive gnomes to accept you as one of their Bigfoots. Now you are ready to help them. With big feet big missions seen to come.
achievement.299.name: Becoming a Bigfoot
achievement.300.description: You think the gnomes start to like you. A little step for a Bigfoot but a big step for humanity.
achievement.300.name: Gnome Little Helper
achievement.301.description: The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
achievement.301.name: Gnome Friend
achievement.302.description: You have become a household name in gnomish society! Your name is mentioned by gnomes more than once. Of course usually by gnomish mothers whose children refuse to eat their mushroom soup, but you are certainly making some tremendous progress.
achievement.302.name: Gnomelike
achievement.303.description: You accomplished what few humans ever will: you truly impressed the gnomes. This might not change their outlook on humanity as a whole, but at least you can bathe in gnomish respect! And don't forget you're now allowed to enter the warzones!
achievement.303.name: Honorary Gnome
achievement.304.description: You brought two loving crystals together. Perhaps they might even name one of their children after you. Too bad you forgot to leave your calling card.
achievement.304.name: Crystals in Love
achievement.305.description: Ring-a-ding! You have visited the golem workshop and lent a hand in repairing them. To know those golems are safe is worth all the bruises, isn't it?
achievement.305.name: Substitute Tinker
achievement.306.description: After hunting for the correct mushrooms and their spores you're starting to feel like a mushroom yourself. A few times more and you might start thinking like a mushroom, who knows?
achievement.306.name: Spore Hunter
achievement.307.description: Burnt fingers and itching lungs are a small price for bringing those gnomes some lousy stone and getting almost killed! Your mother warned you to better become a farmer.
achievement.307.name: Grinding Again
achievement.308.description: Seen it all. Done it all. Your unstoppable force swept through the dungeons and you vanquished their masters. Not to forget the precious loot you took! Now stop reading this and continue hunting! Time is money after all!
achievement.308.name: Dungeon Cleaner
achievement.309.description: So you repaired the light of some crystals for those gnomes. What's next? Sitting a week in a mushroom bed as a temporary mushroom?
achievement.309.name: Crystal Keeper
achievement.310.description: Admittedly you enjoyed the killing as usual. But the part with the sparks still gives you shivers ... or is it that there is some charge left on you?
achievement.310.name: Call Me Sparky
achievement.311.description: One Bigfoot won over thousands of tiny feet. Perhaps the gnomes are wrong and size matters?
achievement.311.name: One Foot Vs. Many
achievement.312.description: The gnomes decided their pigs need some exclusive diet and you had to do all the dirty work - but wasn't the piglet adorable?
achievement.312.name: The Picky Pig
achievement.313.description: You killed the ambassador of the abyss that often that they might consider sending another one. Perhaps that will one day stop further intrusions.
achievement.313.name: Diplomatic Immunity
achievement.314.description: Have you ever wondered how he reappears again and again? You only care for the loot, do you? Gotcha!
achievement.314.name: Fall of the Fallen
achievement.315.description: Again and again Deathstrike has fallen to your prowess. Perhaps it's time for people calling YOU Deathstrike from now on.
achievement.315.name: Death on Strike
achievement.316.description: The face of the enemy is unmasked. You have encountered one of 'those below' and survived. More than that, you managed to kill the beast and prove once and for all that the enemy can be beaten.
achievement.316.name: Death from Below
achievement.317.description: The fallen gnome is dead and justice served. But what was it that the gnome whispered with his last breath? He's your father???
achievement.317.name: Gnomebane's Bane
achievement.318.description: The mighty Deathstrike is dead! One legend is dead and you're on your way to become one yourself.
achievement.318.name: Final Strike
achievement.319.description: Seeing a mucus plug makes your heart dance and you can't resist to see what it hides. Goo goo away!
achievement.319.name: Goo Goo Dancer
achievement.320.description: Finally your dream to become a walking mushroom has come true ... No, wait a minute!
achievement.320.name: Funghitastic
achievement.321.description: If the gnomes had told you that crystal armor is see-through you had probably changed your underwear in time.
achievement.321.name: Crystal Clear
achievement.322.description: You have unleashed your inner gnome and slain some of the most fearsome threats that gnomekind has ever faced. Now you can come and go to the warzones as it pleases you. The enemies of gnomekind will never be safe again.
achievement.322.name: Gnomish Art Of War
achievement.324.description: You conquered the demon challenge and prevailed... now show off your success in style!
achievement.324.name: True Dedication
achievement.325.description: Helping a poor, stupid goblin to feed his starving children and wifes feels good ... if you'd only get rid of the strange feeling that you're missing something.
achievement.325.name: Task Manager
achievement.326.description: Assisting Omrabas' sick plan to resurrect made you dig your way through the blood-soaked halls of Drefia. Maybe better he failed!
achievement.326.name: Gravedigger
achievement.327.description: You cleansed your soul in serving the Repenter enclave and purified thine self in completing all tasks in a single day of labour.
achievement.327.name: Repenter
achievement.328.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your blade into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.328.name: Umbral Swordsman
achievement.331.description: You have helped the gnomes of the spike in securing the caves and explored enough of the lightles depths to earn you a complete cave explorers outfit. Well done!
achievement.331.name: Cave Completionist
achievement.332.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your slayer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.332.name: Umbral Bladelord
achievement.333.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your axe into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.333.name: Umbral Headsman
achievement.334.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your chopper into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.334.name: Umbral Executioner
achievement.335.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your mace into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.335.name: Umbral Brawler
achievement.336.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your hammer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.336.name: Umbral Berserker
achievement.337.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your bow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.337.name: Umbral Archer
achievement.338.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your crossbow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.338.name: Umbral Marksman
achievement.339.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your spellbook into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.339.name: Umbral Harbinger
achievement.340.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify all kinds of weapons into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world. Respect!
achievement.340.name: Umbral Master
achievement.341.description: You collected all of the mysterious bottle messages around the island of Roshamuul and located the remains of the first mate. Time will tell if his tale of mending an evil ring holds true.
achievement.341.name: Nevermending Story
achievement.342.description: What a scientific discovery - they really DO communicate! Using their own communication habits against them, you lured a large pack of silencers away from the walls of Roshamuul.
achievement.342.name: Luring Silence
achievement.343.description: You did not show any signs of surrender to any sight of... you get the picture. Even a hundred of them did not pose a threat to you.
achievement.343.name: Never Surrender
achievement.344.description: You have mended many a broken dream and so, the dream of Roshamuul is safely being told over and over again.
achievement.344.name: Dream Wright
achievement.345.description: You have cleansed the lands of many retching horrors. You sure know how to end a bad dream: forcefully, that's how!
achievement.345.name: Ending the Horror
achievement.346.description: You know your way, in dream and waking. And how to make tea that transcends the boundaries of conscience.
achievement.346.name: Sleepwalking
achievement.347.description: It doesn't matter what noise you would hear... dream, nightmare, illusion - there is nothing you can't vanquish. You are a true Dream Warden.
achievement.347.name: Dream Warden
achievement.348.description: Gaz'haragoth... a day to remember! Your world accomplished something really big - and you have been part of it!
achievement.348.name: Prison Break
achievement.349.description: After a battle like this you know who your friends are.
achievement.349.name: Noblesse Obliterated
achievement.350.description: Through the spirit of science and exploration, you have discovered how to enter the secret hideout of the renowned Dr Merlay.
achievement.350.name: Elementary, My Dear
achievement.351.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Commoner.
achievement.351.name: Rathleton Commoner
achievement.352.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Inhabitant.
achievement.352.name: Rathleton Inhabitant
achievement.353.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Citizen.
achievement.353.name: Rathleton Citizen
achievement.354.description: You accomplished 10 or more consecutive chains in a row! That's killing at least 39 creatures in the correct order - now that's combinatorics!
achievement.354.name: Combo Master
achievement.355.description: Though you might have averted a dire threat for Rathleton, this relative peace may only hold for a while. At least you've scavenged an outfit from some of the poor fellows that have fallen prey to death priest Shagron.
achievement.355.name: Glooth Engineer
achievement.356.description: You discovered the Lion's Rock, passed the tests to enter the inner sanctum and finally revealed the secrets of the buried temple. You literally put your head in the lion's mouth and survived.
achievement.356.name: Lion's Den Explorer
achievement.357.description: Adventure is your middle name. You spent much time in dangerous lands and have seen things others only dream of. You know your way around in Tibia - you are a seasoned adventurer now. And your journey has only just begun!
achievement.357.name: Seasoned Adventurer
achievement.358.description: You've got a mind ready to draw strange conclusions that defy the laws of logic and sidestep reality. Or maybe it's just a lucky guess - or adventurous recklessness?
achievement.358.name: Mind the Step!
achievement.359.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Squire.
achievement.359.name: Rathleton Squire
achievement.360.description: He seriously stored away a wallnut? That was a nutty professor indeed.
achievement.360.name: The Professor's Nut
achievement.361.description: You have defeated the wallbreaker and saved the glooth plant.
achievement.361.name: Plant vs. Minos
achievement.362.description: You have defeated the tremor worm - and wonder what kind of fish you'd be able to catch with such a bait.
achievement.362.name: Rumble in the Plant
achievement.363.description: You have defeated the glooth bomb and chopped down a lot of metal monsters on your way.
achievement.363.name: Robo Chop
achievement.364.description: You escaped the glowing hot lava death trap, Professor Maxxen has set for you - Captain Caveworm is indeed proud!
achievement.364.name: Go with da Lava Flow
achievement.365.description: You saw the Crystal Gardens with all their stunning beauty and survived the equally impressive monsters there. In the end you discovered a great evil and destroyed it with the help of a banshee who was not even aware of her support.
achievement.365.name: Wail of the Banshee
achievement.366.description: You are a man of the public. Or of good publicity at least. Through your efforts in advertising the airtight cloth, Zeronex might yet be redeemed - and Rathleton might yet see its first working Gloud Ship.
achievement.366.name: Publicity
achievement.367.description: By restoring the Everhungry Altar, you charmed the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent back into its fitful sleep, twenty miles beneath the sea.
achievement.367.name: Snake Charmer
